text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One week remains before I return to Tokyo. 
During that time, I need to find the 
"form" 
that will bring out Daring Tact's physical 
gifts to their fullest in a race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given our limited time, our focus will 
primarily be internalizing that new form. 
So I begin studying past videos of her 
runs.
choice_data_list:
...Wait. That stride just now... Run it 
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's handheld footage and somewhat 
difficult to make out, but... 
in one run, as she reached top speed, her 
cadence visibly spiked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That particular run wasn't exceptionally 
fast. However, 
if she can reproduce that high cadence 
reliably and sustain her acceleration on 
the straightaway—
choice_data_list: Her final spurt will be monstrous...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The form I envisioned to unlock Daring 
Tact's true potential— 
"Shift to a high cadence when 
accelerating, and overwhelm the field with 
a ferocious late kick."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because Daring Tact has such a sturdy core 
right now, she naturally defaults 
to a stride-heavy running style that uses 
raw muscle to take massive steps.
choice_data_list:
First, let's get you accustomed to running 
at a high cadence.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I see... Understood! 
What kind of training should we do?
choice_data_list:
About that—I'd like to borrow your 
expertise.

About that—I'd like to borrow your 
expertise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact loves nature, and it was out 
in the wilderness that she forged her 
power. 
These majestic mountains raised her. In 
that case, straight to the end—
choice_data_list:
Let's put the mountain's power to work for 
our final polish!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Yes, I'd love nothing more! 
I'm in your hands, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, she had to instantly cut back her 
line to the irregular claps I made. 
We adjusted the rhythm she had developed 
on familiar mountain trails, making 
subtle, precise tweaks to her form.
choice_data_list: Could you show me a good spot for that?
Could you show me a good spot for that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, somewhere comes to mind... 
Though it's a rather steep path. Will you 
be all right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll be fine, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mountain at night teemed with signs of 
wildlife. Among them, I devised an agility 
drill 
where she had to catch the nuts I threw 
into a sack.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...All right, I think that's all of them. 
I was able to react right away to the 
sound of you stepping on a twig, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Maybe that was a bit too easy for you...
Maybe that was a bit too easy for you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Trainer. 
I believe that surface area calculation 
might be mistaken...
choice_data_list: Huh? ...Ah, I misread the numbers...!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? Trainer, aren't you supposed 
to be tutoring her for the written exam? 
Why's Daring Tact the one teaching you?! 
Ahahaha!
choice_data_list:
Ugh, that was just a slip-up... Next one 
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Working closely beside Daring Tact like 
this... 
we spent an entire week in intensive 
training for the entrance exam. And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day before my return to Tokyo. For a 
final check, we held a mock race. 
As the neighbors gathered to watch, the 
one who arrived was—

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
—Titleholder. 
Nice to meet you.
choice_data_list: Nice to meet you... Um...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
She's my childhood friend. We met while 
training in the mountains, 
and we've been close ever since... She 
happened to be visiting home, so I asked 
her to join us.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for agreeing to help, 
Titleholder. 
Give me everything you've got—because I'm 
going to run you down.
choice_data_list: All right, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Now, pick up the pace...! 
HAAAAAAAAAH...!!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...!! She's fast...!
choice_data_list: (Yes! That's it—that's the closing burst!)
(Yes! That's it—that's the closing burst!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The running form that drew out the 
absolute best in Daring Tact, built over a 
week— 
had now culminated in an explosive, 
devastating late kick.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact. 
...You've gotten strong.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
You're not the same girl who just let the 
winds of Cape Erimo toss her around. 
...You've grown. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
With running like that, you'll definitely 
pass Tracen Academy's exam. 
I can't wait! To see you on TV, Daring 
Tact!

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? We're going 
all the way to Tokyo to cheer for her! 
Man, to think such an incredible girl came 
from Hidaka... It really is a "miracle."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............ Everyone. 
Thank you so much... for everything you've 
done.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I won't be coming back empty-handed. 
—I will pass, without fail. I promise... I 
will bring smiles to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My final night in Hokkaido. While I hadn't 
done any of the sightseeing I'd planned, 
meeting a diamond in the rough like Daring 
Tact made it... the best time imaginable.
choice_data_list: ...Oh, an incoming call.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hello... Trainer? I'm sorry for calling 
so late. 
Do you have a moment? There's something 
I'd like to ask..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Keep walking straight ahead, please. 
............All right, that's good. 
Please, open your eyes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—I gasped without thinking. Spreading 
across the crisp Hokkaido sky 
was a sea of stars... gleaming brighter 
than anything I'd ever seen in Tokyo.
choice_data_list: Incredible...! It's so breathtaking...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad. I thought this view was the 
only thing worthy of thanking you 
for everything you've done... Truly, thank 
you so much for your help!
choice_data_list: Not at all, I learned so much myself.
Not at all, I learned so much myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, you're a rookie 
trainer... right? 
Which means, the horsegirl under your care 
is...?
choice_data_list: Well, none at all yet...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to warm up by the fire for 
a bit? 
I'll make us some hot chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Actually, I— 
failed the trial for a development club in 
the city.
choice_data_list: What...?! You tried joining one?
What...?! You tried joining one?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I knew that getting guidance from a 
prestigious training club 
was the fastest path to entering Tracen 
Academy... I understood that much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
With everyone back home cheering me on... 
I went into the tryouts full of 
confidence. But—I failed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The reason was... unlike the other girls, 
I had no experience in junior races, 
and they didn't expect my build to fill 
out much... or so they said.
choice_data_list: How could they...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I think it was only natural. After all, 
back then, 
I was just a girl running through the 
mountains. But—

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, maybe Daring Tact really oughta 
leave here 
and find a club that'll take her even now, 
don'tcha think?"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, we'll keep an eye on her mom for 
her... 
Daring Tact's definitely got talent, so 
she needs proper coaching on the 
mainland!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"To think such an incredible talent came 
from a rural town like ours." 
"It's a miracle"... That's what everyone 
tells me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
But you see... 
—It's not a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Life flows in a cycle. Born and raised 
here, everything this land has to offer— 
the mountains, the sea, the wind, and 
everyone's hopes... have all been poured 
into me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided. 
I wouldn't rely on training clubs. I would 
grow strong... with only the support of 
this land.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I, raised by Hidaka, go on to win in 
the Twinkle Series... 
then that will be Hidaka's victory. I can 
prove the greatness of my home...
choice_data_list:
That's why you were so set on training in 
the mountains...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And this strength that I've built up 
over time... 
you were the one who polished it for me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please tell me once more. 
—Can I pass the entrance exam for Tracen 
Academy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the steady gaze fixed on me, I saw an 
unwavering inner strength. She was 
resilient 
in both mind and body, and now—she 
understood her own stride.
choice_data_list: You'll pass, without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
I believe so too!
